reviewed_sources.note: Blueprint main after merged V4-4 PR #8.
CareShift main after merged visual identity/design system PR #16.
Pending mockup pilot branch, 13 ahead / 0 behind at review.

findings.v0_4_change: Preserve ALIGN, DO NOT REWRITE and observed/inferred/proposed separation
findings.rationale: CareShift already applies the Brownfield rule and explicitly labels observed, inferred and proposed UI knowledge.
findings.action: Keep the existing Brownfield evidence and semantics unchanged.

findings.v0_4_change: Runtime-backed API gates and contract evidence
findings.rationale: CareShift is the proving pilot for API implementation, OpenAPI parity, Postman, live HTTP/MySQL QA, security and audit evidence.
findings.action: Grandfather the existing PASS evidence; do not rerun or rewrite it solely for v0.4 adoption.

findings.v0_4_change: Stable numbered web inventory with API responsibilities and web-only exceptions
findings.rationale: The 30-view inventory already uses WEB-### IDs, documents roles/data/actions/states/navigation, preserves web-only behavior and records Brownfield gaps.
findings.action: Keep the semantic inventory as canonical pilot evidence.

findings.v0_4_change: Machine-readable v0.4 inventory representation or compatibility adapter
findings.rationale: v0.4 adds a schema-backed artifact model for AI continuity. CareShift's Markdown inventory is semantically strong but not itself the new JSON schema artifact.
findings.action: When CareShift adopts v0.4, add a non-destructive machine-readable companion or adapter derived from the existing inventory; do not replace the source evidence unnecessarily.

findings.v0_4_change: Explicit identity, tokens, responsive, RBAC presentation, semantic states and accessibility
findings.rationale: CareShift already documents these requirements, including 44 px touch targets, Problem Details states, non-color semantics and reduced motion.
findings.action: Keep these artifacts and treat them as approved design inputs.

findings.v0_4_change: Artifact location registry
findings.rationale: v0.4 allows the consumer to declare its real artifact paths instead of forcing physical path migration.
findings.action: Add artifact_locations during v0.4 adoption pointing to CareShift's existing paths and mockup root.

findings.v0_4_change: Split mockup planning, mockups, visual review and client architecture
findings.rationale: CareShift v0.3 status currently compresses these responsibilities. v0.4 makes the gates independently auditable.
findings.action: Add the v0.4 post-API phase names/checks when the consumer version is upgraded; preserve completed earlier evidence.

findings.v0_4_change: Interface slices and scoped gates
findings.rationale: v0.4 permits a coherent slice to progress without granting approval to unrelated interfaces or platforms.
findings.action: Represent Operational Core as an interface slice and use scoped visual_review_pass/client_architecture_ready entries when adoption occurs.

findings.v0_4_change: Maximum 10 views, inventory traceability, API IDs and repository-owned assets
findings.rationale: The pending batch already contains exactly ten planned views, stable inventory/API IDs and versioned asset paths.
findings.action: Keep the batch composition, specifications, prompts and asset files.

findings.v0_4_change: v0.4 mockup batch schema and per-view review fields
findings.rationale: The v0.3 pilot manifest lacks interface_slice, per-view platform, review_status, contract_review_status, accessibility_review_status, reference_inputs and evidence IDs required by v0.4.
findings.action: When resuming the pilot, migrate or add a v0.4-compatible manifest while preserving the ten view IDs, API mappings, four existing assets and six pending states.

findings.v0_4_change: GENERATED != REVIEWED != APPROVED
findings.rationale: The four SVGs are generated references only. File existence cannot satisfy manual, contract or accessibility approval.
findings.action: Keep all four current visuals at GENERATED until explicit review records PASS/APPROVED.

findings.v0_4_change: Per-slice visual review before implementation
findings.rationale: The current branch has generated assets but no v0.4 scoped visual gate evidence.
findings.action: Perform contract, accessibility and manual review for the target slice before any React implementation is unblocked.

findings.v0_4_change: Four generated SVG references
findings.rationale: The assets are already repository-owned and mapped to WEB-001, WEB-004, WEB-005 and WEB-006.
findings.action: Preserve and review them; do not regenerate merely to fit v0.4.

findings.v0_4_change: Six remaining Operational Core mockups
findings.rationale: Completing the images is product work, not required to validate the master Blueprint v0.4 contract.
findings.action: Resume generation only when CareShift returns to mockup execution.

findings.v0_4_change: Canonical web client architecture contract
findings.rationale: No slice has visual_review_pass yet, so client architecture must not be declared PASS.
findings.action: After an interface slice is visually approved, create a CareShift web client architecture artifact bound to that slice and API IDs.

findings.v0_4_change: Web implementation and release cutover
findings.rationale: CareShift's existing Livewire/Blade client remains functional and v0.4 forbids replacing it before scoped visual/client architecture and integration gates.
findings.action: Keep Livewire active; start React only for an approved slice and cut over only after integration/release evidence.

findings.v0_4_change: Explicit coexistence/cutover/rollback plan
findings.rationale: v0.4 makes coexistence a required Brownfield client-architecture decision rather than relying only on the general preserve-working-behavior rule.
findings.action: Require coexistence, cutover criteria and rollback strategy in the future CareShift client architecture artifact.

findings.v0_4_change: Android client architecture and implementation contract
findings.rationale: CareShift declares android=false and no Android source exists in the pilot repository.
findings.action: No Android artifact or gate is required for this pilot.

findings.v0_4_change: Materialized Blueprint v0.4 skills
findings.rationale: The master Blueprint now provides executable reusable procedures. They should be consumed from the adopted Blueprint version rather than copied into CareShift.
findings.action: On v0.4 adoption, use the master materialized skills as procedures while keeping CareShift-specific knowledge in CareShift.

findings.v0_4_change: Existing mockup batch validator and CI
findings.rationale: The pending branch already has project-specific batch validation. Product-specific validation may remain alongside Blueprint schema validation.
findings.action: Keep it; extend or compose it with v0.4 schema validation when the branch resumes.

findings.v0_4_change: Physical relocation into the recommended .blueprint/ui subtree
findings.rationale: v0.4 explicitly permits consumer-defined artifact paths and non-destructive compatibility aliases.
findings.action: Do not move files solely for aesthetics; declare real paths instead.

findings.v0_4_change: Change CareShift blueprint.version from 0.3.0 to 0.4.0
findings.rationale: The master Blueprint is still 0.4.0-dev and CareShift must not auto-upgrade before this compliance review is merged and the release/adoption decision is explicit.
findings.action: Keep CareShift on 0.3.0 until Blueprint 0.4.0 is released and a small consumer adoption PR applies the approved compatibility changes.

findings.v0_4_change: Non-normative CareShift registration and tracked mockup branch
findings.rationale: The master registry already records CareShift as an active non-normative reference pilot with the pending mockup branch tracked.
findings.action: Keep the pilot active and attach this compliance review as the latest review evidence.

findings.v0_4_change: v0.4 interface_slices, scoped_gates and artifact evidence types
findings.rationale: These extensions are optional and backward-compatible, allowing old API evidence to remain valid while new UI work becomes slice-scoped.
findings.action: During CareShift v0.4 adoption, add only the new slice/scoped UI structures needed for future work and grandfather prior PASS evidence.
